input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: The grant meets the preferred position on every material term. Section 13.1 extends the subscription licence to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf (no notice condition needed), with Authorized User rights. Section 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up or embedded Vendor Technology, including contractor support rights, and Section 14.3 confirms that licence applies to Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable. Section 13.3 makes the licence transferable to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right (which permits M&A/successor assignment without consent) and bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity — i.e., not revocable at Vendor's will. Section 13.4 restrictions are narrow and carve out lawful reverse engineering, authorized security testing, and use of Customer Data and output. No redline required.
